document.abstract: After an explanation of the term Class A-B and a brief specification nj such a recording system, the general requirements for the operation operation Class A-B system are given und illustrated. Differences between the operation of push-pull photocells and push-pull vacuum tubes are pointed out and explained, and a discussion of the relotive advantages of Class A, Class A-B, and Class B push-pull tracks is given.
